title: Ish Akanour's releases, "Hustle": a powerful and emotional tribute to the late rapper PNB Rock.
htmlContent:
Ish Akanour's latest release, "Hustle," is a powerful and emotional tribute to the late rapper PNB Rock, who passed away in 2021. The song features an infectious hook that Ish crafted by flipping the chorus of PNB Rock's hit track "Too Many Years," which he had been listening to all day after hearing the news of the artist's passing. The result is a beautifully layered track that showcases Ish's unique style of weaving inspiring lyrics with thumping trap beats and moody arrangements.

Born in Agadir, Morocco, Ish's multicultural upbringing heavily influences his sound, as he infuses his music with a unique vibrato reminiscent of the Imam's prayers he heard growing up. As an independent hip-hop artist, Ish has gained significant traction, earning features on Spotify's official playlists and Gary Vee's Monday to Monday playlist.

In "Hustle," Ish delivers a powerful message about perseverance and determination, reminding listeners that success comes from hard work and hustle. It's a track that will resonate with anyone who has faced adversity or struggled to achieve their dreams. With its infectious beat and relatable lyrics, "Hustle" is a must-listen for hip-hop and rap fans.
